en.headline: Taxi collides with police car in Kwai Chung, three injured
en.dek: The taxi driver and two officers reported injuries after the crash at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street on Monday night; all were conscious.
body: A taxi collided with a police car at the junction of Kwai Fuk Road and Shing Fuk Street in Kwai Chung on Monday night, injuring three people, police said.

The incident occurred at about 9pm. The taxi driver reported leg injuries while two officers in the police vehicle reported pain in their arms and legs. All three were conscious and taken to hospital for treatment.
Police are investigating the cause of the accident. The same junction was the scene of another collision involving a green minibus and a light goods vehicle on 2 August that left six people injured.

zh.headline: 葵涌的士攔腰撞警車 三人受傷送院
zh.dek: 周一晚葵福路與盛福街交界發生交通意外，的士司機及兩名警員報稱受傷，全部清醒送院，警方正調查成因。
body: 周一晚上約9時，一輛的士駛至葵涌葵福路與盛福街交界時，攔腰撞向一輛警車。
的士司機報稱腳部受傷，警車上兩名警員報稱手腳痛楚，三人全部清醒，由救護車送往醫院治理。警方正調查意外成因。
同一路口於8月2日亦曾發生交通意外，當時一輛綠色專線小巴與客貨車相撞，造成六人受傷。
